parsed.name: AMI 持久模式超导磁体线圈
parsed.description: 这是一种带持久开关加热器的超导磁体线圈，可由 AMI 磁体电源励磁，并在持久模式下维持稳定磁场。它常用于低温物理、量子器件和精密电学实验中，为样品提供稳定的直流磁场偏置。
parsed.description_en: A superconducting magnet coil with a persistent switch heater, intended to be energized by an AMI magnet power supply and then operated in persistent mode to maintain a stable magnetic field. It is commonly used in low-temperature physics, quantum-device experiments, and precision electrical measurements to provide a stable DC magnetic bias field.
